libs.note: BH-10124: the reads behind Millwright's metric failed_bakes_and_broken_boxes (failed pool image bakes from state/fleet-propagate.json .pool_fail; boxes with a broken resolv.conf or a full /tmp from a read-only ssh probe; a stale bin from box_status.harness_lag_min). Applied with lib_env_apply staff-millwright by bin/staff/millwright-collect.sh and bin/staff/millwright-lever.sh. Note: docs/notes/2026-11-25-BH-10124-millwright.md.

knobs.note: A box's /tmp is full at or above this block use% (df -P). Out of range is one warn line in logs/staff.log and the default.

Each box probe (one ssh read of /etc/resolv.conf and df /tmp) runs under timeout this many seconds; all probes run in parallel, so one read lasts about this long. A box that does not answer is unreachable, never a fault.

A box_status harness_lag_min reading counts for stale-bin only when its lag_checked_at is younger than this many minutes (bin/fleet-version-check.sh writes it every 10 min). An older reading is unknown.
At most this many registry boxes are probed per read; the rest are not probed and one warn line says so.
Test seam: the ssh command, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: the epoch the reads use as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.

Test seam: a file bin/staff/millwright-collect.sh sources after its libs (the lever's read is the lane knob staff-millwright-lever/MW_FIXTURE), only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam: the resolv.conf path the LOCAL hub probe reads, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. Never sent to a box. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: the /tmp path the LOCAL hub probe reads, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. Never sent to a box. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam gate: the millwright reads honor MW_SSH, MW_NOW, MW_FIXTURE, MW_RESOLV and MW_TMPDIR only when this is 1. Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
